patterns.name: generalized q-logarithm Pade comparator
patterns.one_liner: The generalized q-logarithm paper supplies q-Pade and Hankel determinant tactics for adjacent q-series, with a boundary around direct mu-weight transfer.
patterns.adoption_action: Use as a q-Pade comparator when checking whether a proposed construction has a source precedent.
patterns.relevance_justification: Distillation row is a route handle for the Erdos #249 paper packet, not proof authority.
patterns.rejection_reason: The generalized q-logarithm target has different coefficient structure from the mu-weighted second-power Lambert value.
patterns.reevaluation_trigger: Reopen if a construction maps the mu target into the generalized q-logarithm framework with preserved denominator arithmetic.
